name: Doripure!
source:
Jouichi Shikigami, a sixteen-year-old third-year student at Virtue University, is quite the pedophile.

Then, two sisters named "Seia" and "Mia" from another world, "Titia," appear in front of him. They ask Joichi to become a "Dream Player (DP)" who can take away people's nightmares.

"I can only rely on you, big brother!

In the city of Toshitoku, where Joichi lives, various nightmares are somehow spreading among the girls.

But the DP's mission, though rare, involves a risk to life. Scared, Joichi decides to turn down their request as soon as possible.


Then, a mysterious old man named Naojiro Togi gives Joichi the Pink Deesa. With the power of the Pink Deisa, DP will be able to have sex in his dreams, just like in real life.

Instantly feeling horny, Joichi offered to become a "trial DP" to Seia and Mia. In order to enter their dreams, they must use a magical cell phone called a "Disaphone.

Joichi's first task was to remove the nightmares of Mio Sakura, who lived in his neighborhood. Because of her nightmares, Mio has been wetting the bed frequently lately.

What is causing Mio's nightmares is a mysterious entity called "Rune"...

[Translated from [url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=208]the official website[/url]]
translation:
十六岁的德大学三年级学生城一式神是个十足的恋童癖者。

然后，来自异世界“蒂蒂亚”的两姐妹“塞亚”和“米娅”出现在他的面前。他们要求城一成为一名可以带走人们噩梦的“梦想玩家（DP）”。

“我只能靠你了，大哥！

在城一居住的利德市，各种各样的噩梦不知何故在女孩们中蔓延。

但DP的任务虽然很少见，但却涉及生命危险。城一害怕了，决定尽快拒绝他们的要求。


然后，一位名叫Naojiro Togi的神秘老人将Pink Deesa交给了Joichi。借助Pink Deisa的力量，DP将能够在梦中做爱，就像在现实生活中一样。

城一立刻感到性欲旺盛，主动提出要成为Seia和Mia的“试用DP”。为了进入他们的梦想，他们必须使用一部名为“Disaphone”的神奇手机。

城一的第一个任务是消除住在他家附近的樱澪的噩梦。因为做恶梦，澪最近经常尿床。

造成澪噩梦的，是一种名为“符文”的神秘存在……”

[翻译自[url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=208]官网[/url]]
